counting_units.candidate_span: One detector-selected field or paragraph with at least one authenticated source-byte match; repeated fields and legal text can recur.
counting_units.not_certified: Neither count is an actual-use denominator, unique copied-work count, rights grant, semantic-review count, or adopted-control count.
counting_units.source_match_association: One matched candidate-to-source relation. A candidate may match multiple sources.

existing_rights_finding_references.interpretation: The triage binds each retained record to the original file hash and record digest. Existing finding statuses do not supply output-specific grants or complete-use certification.

incomplete_format_work.scan_error: Expecting property name enclosed in double quotes: line 23 column 45 (char 405)

limitations: Categories describe detector observations, not ownership, originality, licensing or semantic review.
Exact matches establish bytes, not historical copying direction or permission; common and legal text can match several sources.
No match and no source locator cannot establish independent creation or absence of upstream expression.
Only named fields, source associations and paragraphs are tested; transformed, short, uncited, binary and externally inherited expression require review.
Compressed-container ranges locate decoded payload bytes and are not valid publication output spans without a concrete distribution-form review.
This packet is not a publication use register, clearance result, authority policy or approval receipt.

remaining_review_requirements.AUTHORSHIP_AND_AUTHORITY: Identify the output author or rights holder and verify authority for the intended distribution; Git authorship and repository ownership are not grants.
remaining_review_requirements.CLASSIFICATION: Review every output and classify each actual upstream use; the machine category is not a semantic disposition.
remaining_review_requirements.CONTAINER_CONTENTS: Review decoded container contents and any rendering or redistribution form; the compressed file hash alone does not classify its content.
remaining_review_requirements.EXACT_SCOPE_APPROVALS: Supply the separately authorized inventory review, independent audit, human acceptance and distribution decision; this triage supplies none.
remaining_review_requirements.EXPRESSION_GRANT_AND_ATTRIBUTION: For actual copied or adapted expression, determine component-specific grants, restrictions, attribution and modification notices, and bind exact source/output spans.
remaining_review_requirements.LOCATOR_REPAIR: Resolve missing or mismatched source commits and paths without inventing membership in the pinned corpus.
remaining_review_requirements.MANUAL_FORMAT_REVIEW: The declared file format could not be fully parsed; inspect the exact bytes and identify all source uses manually or repair the format in a new candidate.
remaining_review_requirements.OMISSION_AUDIT: An independent reviewer must assess omitted, transformed, inherited and uncited expression beyond the detector rules.
remaining_review_requirements.SOURCE_BODY_COMPARISON: Compare the exact proposed output with authenticated pinned source bytes; no match is not evidence of independent creation.
remaining_review_requirements.TEMPLATE_OR_CODE_ORIGIN: Inspect template, implementation, fixture and prompt ancestry, including inherited examples and dependencies not identifiable by six-source locators.

scope: Navigation for exact-scope publication review. Observed source equality and structural categories do not classify actual uses or grant permission.

unresolved_locator_work.interpretation: Unresolved locators include directory references, stale or mismatched paths, and references outside the fixed six-source corpus. They are review work, not 224 confirmed content errors; no extra corpus membership is inferred.
